status: strict native-action pipeline implemented and all-episode command integrity audited; physical model and historical recording calibration identity remain unvalidated
purpose: Identify simulation parameters while keeping recorded native actions unchanged, for policy transfer to the real SO-101.

native_action.body_joint_units: degrees when use_degrees=True, as in the currently installed default
native_action.semantics: absolute position targets, not torques or target velocities

local_evidence.recording_order: observe state; obtain/process action; send action; store observation and action_values
local_evidence.recording_caveat: The current recorder saves action_values, not the returned _sent_action. Identity processors and no relative-target clipping imply the same targets, but historical configuration is not embedded in this dataset.

strict_replay_invariants: Keep native recorded action arrays unchanged; save their hash and a copy of the applied native action stream.
Use a documented fixed hardware-to-model coordinate/unit conversion, including gripper normalization, encoder calibration and model joint reference frames.
Apply action at its recorded frame interval; do not use future actions for interpolation. Model physical actuator latency explicitly.
Use observation.state only for initial conditions and calibration/evaluation losses; never as the subsequent arm command stream.
Do not use IK, tabletop-clearance target changes, object-conditioned waypoints, grasp/release retiming or hidden action clipping.
Only integrate dynamic object states after initialization; no object teleports, welds or external object forces.
Keep collision detection enabled; correct measured geometry/model parameters when observed real motions intersect simulated geometry.
Export simulated observations in the real robot's native observation convention and camera interfaces.
fit_parameters: joint reference offsets/signs established by physical frame calibration
actuator gains, passive damping, reflected inertia, friction and torque/speed limits
command latency and motor response using fixed recorded action timing
link geometry/inertia, gripper surfaces and measured object dimensions
evaluation: Joint/state trajectory error, lag, gripper aperture and object motion on withheld whole episodes, as well as pick/place success. Calibration changes must be shared across episodes.

previous_results.39_of_72: Measured-state arm targets with tabletop-clearance corrections; NOT strict action replay.
previous_results.72_of_72: Additional trajectory and gripper-timing repair; NOT evidence of direct sim-to-real action compatibility. Archived only.

implementation.gripper_mapping: (range_max-range_min)*360/4095/100 degrees per native unit; model closed reference -10 degrees remains provisional
implementation.success_interpretation: Task criteria only; physical fidelity unvalidated. Initial penetration screen reported separately.
